scientific_role: fully disjoint candidate-frame confirmation; not structural-selector validation and not a change to the validated Japanese ACSP robust product or confirmed automatic global adapter
question: Across all previously unused Japan38 Cirsium concepts retained in the frozen v2 roster, does a training-only BROAD land candidate universe materially increase novel later-population reachability beyond a bounded LOCAL frame?

fixed_region_registry.selection_rule: Choose the fixed region with the largest number of strict 2000-2020 population clusters; ties follow existing VALIDATED_JAPAN_REGIONS order. If all regions have zero strict historical populations, retain the taxon as NO_HISTORICAL_ANCHOR and do not replace it.

land_filter.mode: official 3-degree COG point sampling at frozen candidate coordinates

outcome.novel_population_rule: Apply the same declared uncertainty <=1 km rule, then deterministic complete-link 0.5 km; a recent cluster is novel when >0.5 km from every strict historical population in the selected fixed region

primary_endpoint.contrast: BROAD_LAND full-frame recall minus LOCAL_5KM_LAND full-frame recall at 1.0 km
primary_endpoint.zero_recent_or_zero_novel_taxa: retain as non-evaluable/zero-information; never replace after outcome opening
primary_endpoint.interpretation: candidate-universe adequacy only; BROAD is a superset of LOCAL so nonnegative differences do not imply selector superiority

secondary_outputs: constructible/no-anchor/provider-failure counts across all 31 frozen taxa
candidate counts and strict historical/recent/novel population counts for every taxon
next_stage_if_pass: On a new disjoint cohort, compare source-backed structural/DETACHED ranking with strong spatial coverage within an adequate frozen candidate universe; do not use this outcome cohort to tune selectors.
forbidden: do not change roster membership after outcome opening
do not select regions using 2021-2025 information
do not relax historical or recent 1000-m precision rules
do not treat missing uncertainty as exact/evaluable
do not tune LOCAL radii or WorldCover land classes after outcome opening
do not fit or nominate structural/spatial selectors on this cohort
do not add access roads trails travel budget or cost to ecological candidate membership
do not call broad full-frame reachability field efficiency occupancy probability or exact-site prediction
do not modify the independently validated Japanese robust product or confirmed automatic global adapter
